title: The CHECK → ACT contract
description: What executor check() returns: the action list a cheap, context-isolated CHECK agent emits and the orchestrator's ACT half performs. This is the entire interface between the two halves of a tick — the CHECK reads signals and computes, the ACT touches the world — so an action shape the ACT has no handler for must fail validation here rather than be silently dropped there. Pass this file as the structured-output schema when spawning the CHECK (Claude subagent schema / codex exec --output-schema).

summary.description: One line, human-readable — what this tick found and did. Surfaced to the goal/loop driver.

state_written.description: Whether the CHECK wrote the updated autopilot-state.json + autopilot-status.md itself. When false the ACT must not assume state reflects this tick.

workspace.description: Target workspace name; null for actions with no workspace yet (a fresh launch, a design routing)

message.description: Exact text to deliver for a nudge — the ACT relays it verbatim over the workspace's backend transport, never paraphrased

reason.description: For escalate/design: one line on what the CHECK could not decide

readopt.description: On launch: re-spawn into the existing worktree with the recovery bootstrap (orphan re-adoption) instead of creating one
